WITH flow_data AS (
  SELECT 
    d."RecordRegistry",
    d.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS dest_country,
    dp."dataSense",
    dp.vol_gb,
    sp.enc_state,
    sp.acl_state,
    sp.authMeth
  FROM "DataFlow" d
  JOIN "DataProfile" dp ON d."RecordRegistry" = dp."Flow_Sign"
  JOIN "SecurityProfile" sp ON dp.profileTrace = sp.profile_key
)
SELECT 
  dest_country,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count,
  AVG(vol_gb) AS avg_vol_gb,
  ROUND(CAST(AVG(
    CASE 
      WHEN dataSense IN ('Critical', 'High') THEN vol_gb * 3
      WHEN dataSense = 'Medium' THEN vol_gb * 2
      ELSE vol_gb * 1
    END
  ) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_dsi,
  ROUND(CAST(AVG(
    CASE 
      WHEN enc_state = 'Full' AND acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3
      WHEN enc_state = 'Full' OR acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END
  ) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_srs
FROM flow_data
WHERE dataSense IN ('Critical', 'High')
GROUP BY dest_country
ORDER BY avg_dsi DESC
LIMIT 20;
